headline: Terry Fox Foundation receives record $25M donation
meta_description: The Tanenbaum family makes a historic $25 million gift to the Terry Fox Foundation, marking the largest donation in the organization's history.
summary_short: The Tanenbaum family has given the Terry Fox Foundation a record-breaking $25 million donation, the largest gift in the foundation's history.
body:
The Terry Fox Foundation has received a record-breaking $25 million donation from the Tanenbaum family, marking the largest single gift in the organization's history.

This unprecedented contribution represents a major milestone for the foundation, which has long worked to advance cancer research and support the legacy of Terry Fox's Marathon of Hope. The scale of the Tanenbaum family's generosity underscores the deep commitment among philanthropic leaders to accelerate progress against cancer.

The donation opens new possibilities for the foundation's research initiatives and programs, strengthening its ability to fulfill its mission across Canada and beyond.
quick_facts: Largest gift in Terry Fox Foundation history
Supports cancer research and legacy programs
